method: Read-only os.open(O_RDONLY) and os.pread of LBA7, CHS-based LBA7 legacy compatibility extent, eight neighboring sectors, and the earlier physical-total-based candidate
proves: The LBA7-pointed LBA7 legacy compatibility extent is a real isolated six-sector high-entropy block even on this no-password two-entry disk.
The earlier all-zero no-password capture was at the wrong physical address and did not sample LBA7 legacy compatibility extent.
In this two-entry profile only LBA7 type4 points at the LBA7 legacy compatibility extent 0xC00 extent; LBA7 type2 points at the actual Share start LBA63.
does_not_prove: The plaintext layout or actual business purpose of the 3072 bytes.
That the LBA7 legacy compatibility extent bytes are encrypted by the LBA7 wrapped8 key or by the LBA12 SM4 file key.
That a current Windows or Linux client reads this block during login or mount.
